sources.title: Build skills
confirmed_facts: Repository skills use .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. User skills use ~/.agents/skills.
Codex CLI and IDE support /skills selection and $skill-name invocation. Skills can also match requests automatically.
A folder contains SKILL.md plus optional scripts, references and assets. Changes are detected automatically; restart if a change does not appear.

sources.title: Extend Claude with skills
confirmed_facts: Project skills use .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Personal skills use ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
Invoke a project or personal skill as /skill-name. Automatic selection is also supported.
Project skill folders in parent directories are checked up to the repository root. Supporting files may be bundled in a skill folder.

sources.title: Claude Code command-line help, a local install of this repository, and its skill-name rule
sources.method: Ran claude plugin marketplace --help and claude plugin install --help, then claude plugin marketplace add on a local copy of this repository, claude plugin install phpfixes@phpfixes and claude plugin details phpfixes@phpfixes, with an empty configuration. Read the message that the same program shows for an invalid skill name, from the program itself.
confirmed_facts: claude plugin marketplace add <source> adds a marketplace from a URL, a path or a GitHub repository.
claude plugin install <plugin>@<marketplace> installs a plugin from that marketplace.
This repository's marketplace is named phpfixes and installs one plugin, phpfixes, whose one skill is phpfixes-php2shell.

A skill that a plugin provides is named plugin:skill. The invalid-skill-name message says skill names match the skill's directory name, or 'plugin:skill' for plugin-qualified skills. Installed as the phpfixes plugin, this skill is phpfixes:phpfixes-php2shell.

sources.title: skill-installer, a Codex system skill
sources.method: Read the skill-installer SKILL.md preinstalled with Codex, and ran its install-skill-from-github.py on a local archive of this repository with its network call replaced.
confirmed_facts: skill-installer is preinstalled with Codex and installs a skill from a GitHub URL of the form https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/tree/<ref>/<path>.
It installs into $CODEX_HOME/skills/<skill-name>, which defaults to ~/.codex/skills.

sources.title: php2shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619): PHP critical vulnerability fixes available
confirmed_facts: Canonical uses the name php2shell for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.
Canonical distinguishes installed security packages from applications that still need restarting, including Apache mod_php.

sources.title: Security advisory: Critical remote code execution vulnerabilities, update now
confirmed_facts: PHP upstream fixed releases are 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 and 8.5.12.
Distributions and LTS vendors may supply backported fixes. PHP 8.1 and older no longer receive PHP project updates.
Configuration mitigations are partial; updating to a patched build is required for a complete fix.

sources.title: USN-8948-1: PHP vulnerabilities
confirmed_facts: For both CVEs, Ubuntu 24.04 PHP 8.3 is fixed in 8.3.6-0ubuntu0.24.04.13.
Ubuntu 22.04 PHP 8.1 is fixed in 8.1.2-1ubuntu2.28. Ubuntu 26.04 PHP 8.5 is fixed in 8.5.4-0ubuntu1.5; Ubuntu 26.10 PHP 8.5 is fixed in 8.5.9-0ubuntu2.1.
Listed packages include CLI, FPM, CGI and the Apache PHP module. An installed fixed package does not alone establish which build a running worker uses.

sources.title: CVE-2026-109618
confirmed_facts: Debian 12/bookworm security php8.2 is fixed in 8.2.35-1~deb12u1.
Debian 13/trixie security php8.4 is fixed in 8.4.27-1~deb13u1.

sources.title: CVE-2026-109619
confirmed_facts: The same Debian 12 and Debian 13 fixed revisions cover CVE-2026-109619.

sources.title: DSA-6574-1
confirmed_facts: php8.4 in Debian 13/trixie security fixed in 8.4.27-1~deb13u1.
The advisory explicitly lists Debian 13/trixie php8.4 8.4.24-1~deb13u1 as vulnerable to the two referenced CVEs. This exact affected build is bundled; no other unlisted older base is inferred.

sources.title: DLA-4848-1
confirmed_facts: php8.2 in Debian 12/bookworm security fixed in 8.2.35-1~deb12u1.
The advisory explicitly lists Debian 12/bookworm php8.2 8.2.32-1~deb12u1 as vulnerable to the two referenced CVEs. This exact affected build is bundled; no other unlisted older base is inferred.
